item.summary: The National Land Monetization Corporation (NLMC), under the administrative control of the Department of Public Enterprises (DPE), Ministry of Finance, Government of India, organised a Pre-Bid Meeting in New Delhi today, in connection with the proposed e-auction of a strategically located land parcel owned by HIL (India) Limited.
item.title: NLMC Organises Pre-Bid Meeting for E-Auction of 5.119-Acre HIL (India) Limited Land Parcel in New Delhi
